grecque, p. 611 s.
sections.en: 1 The Fathers of the Church often contended that astrology had formerly been a true science but that it was made false by the advent of Christ. Cf. Bouché-Leclercq, Astrol. grecque, p. 611 f.

summary.headline: Patristic Critique of Astrology
summary.text: Critique of astrology as false or impious after Christ, citing Basil, Paul, John Chrysostom, Galen, and Hippocrates; it argues that disease cycles arise from matter and nature rather than celestial necessity or forces descending from above.
